provenance.instrument: Code of the Township of Whitehall, Chapter 27 Zoning (Ord. No. 1651, 9-18-1989, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: Chapter 27 adopted 9-18-1989, amended many times. 27-137.1 short-term rentals added 3-13-2023 (Ord. 3298). eCode360 New Laws (read 2026-11-12) list Ord. 3442 (zoning map, 9-14-2026) and non-zoning items. No text amendment to Chapter 27 is pending there.
provenance.code_current_through_note: Date carried from the towns index. The print view read on 2026-11-12 shows no currency line. New Laws lists items to 2026-09-14.
checks: The code expressly prohibits 'The use of a detached accessory building as a dwelling' (27-62D). A unit inside or attached to the house is not named, but it is an unlisted use, also prohibited (27-62A)
It also prohibits 'A use not listed in a zoning district schedule and not similar as per 27-63' (27-62A). No district lists an accessory dwelling unit, and no district lists a two-family dwelling
R-1 to R-4 permit only single-family detached dwellings as housing (27-70A to 27-74A). Semidetached, attached and apartment dwellings appear only in R-5, R-5A and R-6

The similar-use special exception (27-63) cannot treat a use listed in another district as similar. A rented second unit is an 'apartment' (Article XVI: leased for at least 30 days), listed in R-5, so it cannot be a similar use. An unleased family suite inside the house is not an apartment as defined, so a special exception as similar to a single-family dwelling (27-63), or a customary accessory use (27-70B(1), 27-58), is arguable. Ask the zoning officer

Detached accessory buildings on lots under one acre: 22 ft high and no more than 1,200 sq ft or the house's footprint perimeter area, whichever is smaller. 3 ft from property lines, not in the front yard (27-84D, E, G)

Accessory uses: 'Any use customarily associated with, incidental to or provided with a permitted use' is allowed by right (27-70B(1)), if customary, in scale and not in a front yard or a side yard on a street (27-58)
Short-term rentals need a license under 27-137.1 (added 2023)
Parking: two spaces per dwelling unit (27-146A(18))
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Whitehall Township Bureau of Planning and Zoning (whitehalltownship.com). Districts (27-66) include R-1, R-2, R-3, R-3A, R-4, R-5, R-5A, R-6 and commercial and industrial districts. Read on eCode360 in a browser, the chapter print view, searched in the page. Searched for accessory dwelling, accessory apartment, apartment accessory, in-law, granny, ECHO, elder cottage, caretaker, guest house, carriage, second dwelling, accessory residential, servant, au pair, accessory unit, tiny, two-family, duplex, conversion, kitchen. No ADU term. 'Adaptive reuse for affordable housing and multifamily housing' is permitted in every residential district, but only for a building first built for commercial, institutional or industrial use (Article XVI). It does not reach a house.

status.note: No ADU text. 27-62D expressly bars 'The use of a detached accessory building as a dwelling', which is kept as a gate on the detached forms. A unit inside or attached to the house is not named. It is an unlisted use under 27-62A ('A use not listed in a zoning district schedule and not similar as per 27-63'). Changed from prohibited after review, since the express bar reaches only detached units. The detached forms are prohibited in adu.status_by_form.

status_by_form.note: 'The use of a detached accessory building as a dwelling' is expressly prohibited.

path.note: A second unit is an unlisted use, prohibited by 27-62A. It needs a use variance from the Zoning Hearing Board (MPC 910.2). A detached unit also runs into the express bar in 27-62D. 27-70B(1) allows by right 'Any use customarily associated with, incidental to or provided with a permitted use', subject to 27-58. A separate dwelling unit is read as not customary.

fallback_path.note: Same as path. 27-63 lets the Zoning Hearing Board find a use similar to a listed one by special exception, but 'No use which is listed in a use schedule of a zoning district ... shall be considered as a similar use in any other zoning district.' A rented unit is an apartment, listed in R-5, so it is not a similar use in R-1 to R-4. An unleased family suite is not an apartment as defined, so a 27-63 special exception may be argued for it. Not set as unlisted_use_path because its reach is unsettled.

alternatives.note: No alternative on a house lot in R-1 to R-4. No two-family dwelling or conversion use exists in Chapter 27. R-5, R-5A and R-6 list semidetached, attached and apartment dwellings as new buildings with their own lot rules.

historic_bypass.note: Historic text in Chapter 27 is floodplain and airport related. No historic path.

value.condition: The use of a detached accessory building as a dwelling is expressly prohibited.

types_allowed.note: No ADU form is listed. A single-family detached dwelling is 'A dwelling unit on a permanent foundation occupied as a residence for one family'.

max_height_ft.note: Accessory building rule, not an ADU rule. 'Detached accessory buildings located on a lot of less than one acre in residential zones ... shall be limited to a height of 22 feet and shall not exceed 1,200 square feet or the square foot perimeter of the primary structure'.

setback_side_ft.note: Accessory building rule. 'must not be less than three feet from all property lines and six feet from any alley right-of-way.'

setback_rear_alley_ft.note: Six feet from any alley right-of-way.

setback_front_ft.note: 'Accessory buildings, structures or uses shall not be located in any front yard area.'

front_yard_barred.note: 'Accessory buildings, structures or uses shall not be located in any front yard area.'

max_adus.note: Reading: 0 means the code allows no ADU. An unleased family suite is the open case, see checks.

short_term_rental_banned.note: Short-term rentals are regulated and licensed under 27-137.1 (added 3-13-2023), not banned outright.

spaces_required.note: No ADU row. 'Residential dwelling: two spaces per dwelling unit.'
